    Integral unit forms #

    A unit form on ℤ^ι is q(x) = Σ_a x_a² + Σ_{a<b} q_ab x_a x_b. We encode it by the symmetric matrix c of its polar form B(x, y) = Σ_{a,b} c_ab x_a y_b with c_aa = 2, so that B(x, x) = 2 q(x). Weak positivity, restrictions and critical forms (Ovsienko) are as in von Höhne, On weakly positive unit forms (1988), §1.
